# Golem, phase 2: materials in exact URBEX 16 colours (sRGB 0..1), joined into the five game parts
# with their pivots, flat shading, export (generated by make_golem.py). Clay #a93130 (clay step 2),
# ClayDark #7a1338 (clay step 1), Band #e0a46e (clay step 3), Glow #579fb4 (rune step 3, unlit),
# Moss #5d7643 (moss step 2).
material new Clay --base-color 0.663 0.192 0.188 --no-slot
material new ClayDark --base-color 0.478 0.075 0.220 --no-slot
material new Band --base-color 0.878 0.643 0.431 --no-slot
material new Glow --base-color 0.341 0.624 0.706 --no-slot
material new Moss --base-color 0.365 0.463 0.263 --no-slot
select Band
active Band
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select FistL
active FistL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select FistR
active FistR
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select FootL
active FootL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select FootR
active FootR
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select ForeL
active ForeL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select ForeR
active ForeR
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select HeadBase
active HeadBase
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select HeadDome
active HeadDome
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select Hips
active Hips
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select KnobL
active KnobL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
delete face
mode object
select KnobR
active KnobR
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
delete face
mode object
select LegL
active LegL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select LegR
active LegR
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select MossL
active MossL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select MossR
active MossR
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select Rim
active Rim
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select UpperL
active UpperL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select UpperR
active UpperR
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select UrnLow
active UrnLow
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select UrnTop
active UrnTop
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select Yoke
active Yoke
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
delete face
mode object
select LegL LegR UrnLow UrnTop HeadBase HeadDome UpperL UpperR ForeL ForeR
material assign Clay
select FootL FootR Hips Rim Yoke KnobL KnobR FistL FistR
material assign ClayDark
select Band
material assign Band
select Visor RuneBar Rune0 Rune1 Rune2 Rune3 Rune4 Rune5 Rune6 Rune7
material assign Glow
select MossL MossR
material assign Moss
select Hips UrnLow UrnTop Band Rim Yoke KnobL KnobR MossL MossR HeadBase HeadDome Visor RuneBar Rune0 Rune1 Rune2 Rune3 Rune4 Rune5 Rune6 Rune7
active UrnLow
join
rename UrnLow Body
cursor set 0 0 0
origin set --to cursor
select UpperL ForeL FistL
active UpperL
join
rename UpperL ArmL
cursor set 0.720 0 1.780
origin set --to cursor
select LegL FootL
active LegL
join
cursor set 0.290 0 0.620
origin set --to cursor
select UpperR ForeR FistR
active UpperR
join
rename UpperR ArmR
cursor set -0.720 0 1.780
origin set --to cursor
select LegR FootR
active LegR
join
cursor set -0.290 0 0.620
origin set --to cursor
select all
shade flat
inspect stats
export golem.glb
